sn12.19:1.2: avijjānīvaraṇassa bhikkhave bālassa taṇhāya saṃyuttassa evamayaṃ kāyo samudāgato
sn12.19:1.3: iti ayañceva kāyo bahiddhā ca nāmarūpaṃ itthetaṃ dvayaṃ dvayaṃ paṭicca phasso saḷevāyatanāni yehi phuṭṭho bālo sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
sn12.19:2.1: avijjānīvaraṇassa bhikkhave paṇḍitassa taṇhāya saṃyuttassa evamayaṃ kāyo samudāgato
sn12.19:2.2: iti ayañceva kāyo bahiddhā ca nāmarūpaṃ itthetaṃ dvayaṃ dvayaṃ paṭicca phasso saḷevāyatanāni yehi phuṭṭho paṇḍito sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
sn12.19:3.1: tatra bhikkhave ko viseso ko adhippāyaso kinnānākaraṇaṃ paṇḍitassa bālenāti.
sn12.19:3.2: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu vata me bhante bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn12.19:4.1: tenahi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
sn12.19:4.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn12.19:5.1: yāya ca bhikkhave avijjāya nivutassa bālassa yāya ca taṇhāya saṃyuttassa ayaṃ kāyo samudāgato sā ceva avijjā bālassa appahīnā sā ca taṇhā aparikkhīṇā
sn12.19:5.3: na hi bhikkhave bālo acari brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhakkhayāya
sn12.19:5.4: tasmā bālo kāyassa bhedā kāyūpago hoti
sn12.19:5.5: so kāyūpago samāno na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn12.19:6.1: yāya ca bhikkhave avijjāya nivutassa paṇḍitassa yāya ca taṇhāya saṃyuttassa ayaṃ kāyo samudāgato sā ceva avijjā paṇḍitassa pahīnā sā ca taṇhā parikkhīṇā
sn12.19:6.3: acari bhikkhave paṇḍito brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhakkhayāya
sn12.19:6.4: tasmā paṇḍito kāyassa bhedā na kāyūpago hoti
sn12.19:6.5: so akāyūpago samāno parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn12.19:6.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyaso idannānākaraṇaṃ paṇḍitassa bālena yadidaṃ brahmacariyavāsoti.
